scripts.check: for dir in packages/*/ examples/*/*/; do (cd "$dir" && tsc) || exit 1; done
scripts.update: bun update && for dir in packages/*/ examples/*/*/; do (cd "$dir" && bun update) || exit 1; done
scripts.update:latest: bun update --latest && for dir in packages/*/ examples/*/*/; do (cd "$dir" && bun update --latest) || exit 1; done
